scenarios.label: Cross-trigger
scenarios.intro: Two classes, one hour of audio in total.

frames.note: Both classes are detected exactly.
The siren detector also fires for 1 s on silence. Each profile counts one false positive per hour, so each loses about 1%.
The same false detection on the speech event. PSDS2 also charges a cross-trigger: one over 3 s of speech, weighted 0.5, is 600 per hour, far past the limit of 100.
